evidence: The XRD analysis of the films was performed using the 1.54056 Cu Ka1 line of a Rigaku Ultima III X-ray diffractometer. The stoichiometry and composition of the films were measured by X-ray photoelectron spectroscopy (XPS) using a PHI 5000 Versaprobe system. The PL and photoluminescence excitation (PLE) characteristics of the specimens were determined using a reconﬁgurable optical bench... Electrical characterization was performed with an Ecopia HM-S5000 Hall effect measurement system... The thickness of the deposited films was determined by a Veeco Dektak 150 stylus proﬁlometer. An Ar+ gun was employed to sputter clean the top 1 nm of the films to remove adventitious carbon.
